description: This file declares functions, utilities, and constants related to XPU device management within the c10::xpu namespace. It includes device querying, setting, property retrieval, and validation functions, serving as an interface for XPU device operations.

methods.name: device_count
methods.description: Returns the number of available XPU devices, logs a warning if none are detected.

methods.name: device_count_ensure_non_zero
methods.description: Returns the number of XPU devices, throws an error if zero are detected.

methods.name: current_device
methods.description: Returns the index of the current XPU device being used.

methods.name: set_device
methods.description: Sets the active XPU device to the specified device index.

methods.name: exchange_device
methods.description: Sets the active device and returns the previous device index.

methods.name: maybe_exchange_device
methods.description: Sets the device if different and returns the new device index.

methods.name: get_raw_device
methods.description: Returns a reference to the raw SYCL device object for the specified device index.

methods.name: get_device_context
methods.description: Returns a reference to the SYCL context for the current device.

methods.name: get_device_properties
methods.description: Fills a DeviceProp structure with properties for the specified device index.

methods.name: get_device_idx_from_pointer
methods.description: Returns the device index associated with a pointer.
